97 Things Every Engineering Manager Should Know工程经理应知的 97 件事

Collective Wisdom from the Experts / 专家集体智慧
Edited by Camille Fournier · O'Reilly · 2019 · 中英对照 HTML 阅读版

A collection of 97 short essays from experienced engineering managers. Topics range from one-on-ones, feedback, culture, hiring, firing, roadmaps, communication, remote work, inclusion, to leadership, willpower, and self-organization. Click any chapter below to read the bilingual text.

来自资深工程经理的 97 篇短文合集。主题涵盖一对一、反馈、文化、招聘、解雇、路线图、沟通、远程工作、包容，到领导力、意志力、自组织。点击下方任意章节阅读中英对照正文。
